name: Triangle bur ragweed
desc: Triangle bur ragweed (Ambrosia deltoidea): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 30 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Ambrosia deltoidea is a North American species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae known by the common names triangle bur ragweed, triangle bursage, and triangleleaf bursage.
